name: Multi-pass GAN for Volumetric Super-Resolution
definition: Physics-informed SR method that decomposes volumetric SR into orthogonal 2D slice passes via a multi-pass GAN, incorporating governing equation constraints directly into the training objective.
summary: Multi-pass GAN performs volumetric super-resolution by decomposing 3D reconstruction into orthogonal 2D slice passes to reduce memory costs, while integrating physics-informed constraints to ensure physically consistent results.
